title: V0.8.2 source and runtime recovery baseline
scope: recover the exact V0.8.2 source and runtime from GitHub
distinguish the historical baseline deployment from the current Production deployment
prove current Production runtime bytes still equal the baseline
prove the recovered runtime boots and completes its existing 1F-through-10F loop
prove schema-2 reload, future-schema non-overwrite, service-worker cache replacement, and offline shell startup
record known defects without silently improving the baseline

outOfScope.item: V0.8.2 product quality or 100-floor Production Ready
outOfScope.reason: Step 1 preserves a legacy comparison and recovery point; it does not approve the legacy game as the target product.

outOfScope.item: recovery of deleted or corrupted real-user localStorage
outOfScope.reason: V0.8.2 has no server backup or export. The baseline can preserve compatibility but cannot recreate data that no longer exists.
That remains mandatory for the later product QA gate. Step 1 must not relabel emulator evidence as physical-device evidence.

requirements.condition: Baseline commit and tree exist and contain every blob without LFS or submodules.
A second remote archive ref points to the exact baseline commit; local-only refs are insufficient.
A complete runtime manifest records source path, served path, byte size, MIME type, and SHA-256.
The historical baseline Vercel deployment is READY and its metadata commit is the baseline commit.
Current Production alias deployment and historical baseline deployment are recorded separately.
Every manifest entry served by the fixed Production URL equals the baseline source bytes.
A clean recovered runtime passes the existing 1F-through-10F deterministic browser loop at 390x844 and 375x667.
Service Worker enabled tests pass online install, controller acquisition, obsolete cache removal, and offline shell restart.
Schema-2 progress reloads and a future-schema save remains byte-for-byte unmodified.
Known save limits, especially non-persistence of the live combat roster, are stated as defects rather than hidden.
At least three independent audits search for reasons to reject the baseline and the final judge resolves every material finding.
No game runtime file is changed by the Step 1 redo.

automaticFailureConditions: a local test passes but the remote recovery ref is absent
Vercel READY is used as the only completion evidence
the current Production deployment commit is falsely reported as the historical baseline commit
only source code or hashes are checked without running the recovered artifact
service workers are blocked in every browser run
future-schema or existing-save preservation is not tested
physical iPhone or real-user save recovery is claimed without evidence
a gameplay, style, asset, manifest, or service-worker file changes during this archival step
